text_block_list.text: Rewinding time a little—right after the expedition team returned from Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad... I made it back...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: We somehow managed to use the international airport... But...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We really had it driven home to us, huh.
All sorts of things...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Through both words and actions...
it was Pisa who moved everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I... couldn't do it...
Not when I've just been treating racing like a game...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Swept up by a surge of emotions...
I just ran...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone who can only pull off moves like that in the clutch...
will never become a ruler."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What am I gonna do... from now on...?

And after returning to Tracen Academy...
many things were said and done.
—I lamented.
—I rampaged.

Overwhelmed by her own helplessness, she holed up
in her room and didn't come out for a while...

Meanwhile, Japan had somehow taken its first step toward recovery,
and glimpses of hope were finally beginning to emerge.

Amidst all this, a small-scale Fan Appreciation Day
was held. As for Rulership...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone!
Board games, board games, let's play board games with me~♪

Once he saw that the nation was somehow
back on track to recovery...
he turned into a guy who simply loved board games.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want to spread the joy of board games to even more fans♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I kinda want to set up a Board Game Department here at Tracen Academy sometime.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait—Board Game Academy!
That's it!"

Her words and actions are... pretty bizarre too.
And the reason for that is...
choice_data_list: Um... what about the ruler's throne...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah... I told you going for that is basically impossible mode...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Racing isn't a game...
You saw Pisa, so you should understand by now.

Indeed, in that tight corner,
it was Victoire Pisa who truly made
her presence felt.

—A difference in temperament. Rulership was
strong in ordinary times, yet weak in times of crisis.
And as for the turnout in the board game room...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Huhhh?
There's only this many...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I seeeeee... Well, I guess nobody would
want to play games with someone like me anyway...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, sorry to bother you, but could you join our table?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Looks like several spots will be short on people.
Could you also take care of the instructions for first-timers?
Even so, to make sure the fans enjoyed themselves, I gave it everything I had.

Even so, the turnout
at the board game room was...
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Rulership!
It's Rulership!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Lady Loula~~!! When I heard I could play with you today, I was so excited to come!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ugh... There are still fans who want to meet someone like me?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's take on as many opponents as we can today. If we do that...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I might actually be able to found a Board Game Academy!
The venue became bustling with activity.

And after closing up shop,
I took a leisurely stroll around the venue...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... If being a ruler is out of the question,
what am I supposed to do from now on...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I should turn over a new leaf or something.
But how do I even do that...?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I should've listened to Air Groove-san
a little more when I was little...

And up on the stage,
there stood Air Groove herself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Allow us to once again introduce our academy's rising star to all the racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —It's Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the introduction.
I am Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I still have a long way to go, but I'm looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Is that... Duramente?
We didn't talk much back at school.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: At the academy, she is Admire Groove... a student of that Alve, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Right now, I have thoughts of my own on the matter.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Our nation is still in the midst of hardship.
The scars of the disaster are still fresh..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: During that time, the very significance of racing—and by extension, sports itself—was shaken to its core.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, Victoire Pisa and Transcend showed us all.
That races are by no means meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I do not yet possess the power to accomplish such a feat.
However—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As our nation recovers, I hope to contribute,
even a little, to restoring the value of sports.
(Wah, *clap clap clap*!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ri... ri... ri...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Magnificentttt!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Did you hear that, Trainer...?
No matter how much I turn over a new leaf,
there's no way I could ever be like that!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I was just playing around the whole time, you know?
What am I supposed to do nowww?!

"Right now, we are in an emergency.
It was a turn for someone with a sense of responsibility to shine."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, for real this time...
I'm completely done for...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've been in pinches before, but this time
it's really, totally, completely over...
I'm cornered on all sides...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Can't find the me I'm aiming for...
A sloppy game with no clear mission...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Everyone is trying to accomplish something through racing, and yet I'm the only one...
choice_data_list: No, that's amazing. You're amazing, too!
No, it's amazing. You're amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
But I can't bring myself to believe that.
Not from the bottom of my heart, not even a little...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Someone like me... Someone like me has nothing...
(*tap-tap-tap-tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just...
give up on racing altogether...
(*tap-tap-tap-tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if I run, having fun,
or entertaining anyone else is no longer...

"That is absolutely!!!!
NOT true!!!!!"

I...!!
I love the way you run!!!!!
"That Umamusume was... the one who always came to watch Rulership's races."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You are...
I am--my name is--

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm Kiseki!
